description: Definition crosswalk for unchanged released values; not a harmonised signature product. Comparator target names use published spelling.

camels_us_addor2017.version: Addor et al. (2017), Tables 2 and 3; hydrological years 1990-2009
camels_us_addor2017.definition_scope: Published definitions, not a claim of bitwise agreement with any downstream implementation.

caravan2023.definition_scope: Framework reference only where a target signature definition was not verified; no universal Caravan signature equivalence is asserted.

row_eligibility: area_km2 < 50000; at least 5 years with >=70% nonmissing daily Q; each annual metric independently needs >=5 nonmissing annual metric values. No A-F or quality_flag mask. is_anomalous rows remain in CSV and are excluded from summary statistics; water_balance_screen does not mask signature computation.

variables.name: q_mean
variables.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of annual values across complete Oct-Sep hydrological years 2009-2023 (2008-10-01 through 2023-09-30); each year has equal weight.
variables.eligibility_and_masks: area_km2 < 50000; at least 5 years with >=70% nonmissing daily Q; each annual metric independently needs >=5 nonmissing annual metric values. No A-F or quality_flag mask. is_anomalous rows remain in CSV and are excluded from summary statistics; water_balance_screen does not mask signature computation.
variables.missing_date_handling: NaN Q omitted within each year; dates are retained for eligibility. Missing days are not zero-filled.
variables.interpolated_discharge: Available Q includes observed and interpolated values (quality_flag 0 and 1); quality_flag is not read by create_paper_signatures.py. Missing Q remains NaN.

comparators.limitations: CAMELS-US uses the record mean; unequal annual coverage makes equal-year and pooled-day weighting differ.
No corresponding signature definition verified in the 2023 source; use the actual target product definition before comparison.

variables.name: runoff_ratio
variables.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of annual values across complete Oct-Sep hydrological years 2009-2023 (2008-10-01 through 2023-09-30); each year has equal weight.
variables.eligibility_and_masks: For each complete hydrological year require >=70% nonmissing Q and >=70% days jointly nonmissing in Q, selected P and GLEAM4 PET; require sum(P)>0 and >=5 such years. PET participates in the mask even for Q/P. No grade or provenance-flag mask.
variables.missing_date_handling: Only jointly available Q/P/PET dates contribute sums; no imputation at signature calculation; incomplete seasonal sampling can bias balance interpretation.
variables.interpolated_discharge: Available Q includes observed and interpolated values (quality_flag 0 and 1); quality_flag is not read by create_paper_signatures.py. Missing Q remains NaN.

comparators.limitations: Mean of annual paired-day ratios differs from a ratio of long-term means; seasonal gaps, storage and forcing differ.
No corresponding signature definition verified in the 2023 source; use the actual target product definition before comparison.

variables.name: flashiness_index
variables.formula: sum(abs(q[i]-q[i-1]), i=1..n-1)/sum(q[i], i=1..n-1), q=Q_window.dropna(); NaN for n<2 or denominator<=0
variables.aggregation: One pooled calculation over all available Q in complete-year window, including years failing the annual 70% rule, after row eligibility is met.
variables.eligibility_and_masks: area_km2 < 50000; at least 5 years with >=70% nonmissing daily Q; each annual metric independently needs >=5 nonmissing annual metric values. No A-F or quality_flag mask. is_anomalous rows remain in CSV and are excluded from summary statistics; water_balance_screen does not mask signature computation.
variables.missing_date_handling: dropna then difference consecutive retained values; calendar gaps are bridged as one step.
variables.interpolated_discharge: Available Q includes observed and interpolated values (quality_flag 0 and 1); quality_flag is not read by create_paper_signatures.py. Missing Q remains NaN.

comparators.limitations: No direct counterpart in Addor2017 Table 3. Denominator excludes first retained Q; gaps are bridged.

variables.name: high_flow_dur
variables.formula: mean_y(mean(lengths of date-contiguous runs where Q_y > 2*median(Q_y))); use 0 for a year without events
variables.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of annual values across complete Oct-Sep hydrological years 2009-2023 (2008-10-01 through 2023-09-30); each year has equal weight.

variables.missing_date_handling: NaN Q omitted; an event breaks when condition becomes false OR successive retained dates differ by more than one day. Hydrological-year boundaries also break events. Length counts retained daily observations.
variables.interpolated_discharge: Available Q includes observed and interpolated values (quality_flag 0 and 1); quality_flag is not read by create_paper_signatures.py. Missing Q remains NaN.

variables.name: baseflow_index
variables.formula: mean_y(mean_alpha(mean(max(B_alpha,0))/mean(q))); q=Q_y.dropna(); if mean(q)==0 BFI=0; 1000 uniform alpha samples on [0.9,0.98], random seed1996, forward-backward-forward filtering and 30-value reflection at each end
variables.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of annual values across complete Oct-Sep hydrological years 2009-2023 (2008-10-01 through 2023-09-30); each year has equal weight.
variables.eligibility_and_masks: area_km2 < 50000; at least 5 years with >=70% nonmissing daily Q; each annual metric independently needs >=5 nonmissing annual metric values. No A-F or quality_flag mask. is_anomalous rows remain in CSV and are excluded from summary statistics; water_balance_screen does not mask signature computation.
variables.missing_date_handling: dropna before filtering; nonadjacent calendar dates become successive filter steps.
variables.interpolated_discharge: Available Q includes observed and interpolated values (quality_flag 0 and 1); quality_flag is not read by create_paper_signatures.py. Missing Q remains NaN.

comparators.limitations: Related filter-derived ratio; CAMELS-US cites Ladson2013 digital filtering, not this annual ensemble implementation. Parameter, boundary and gap handling differ. Not a measured groundwater fraction.
No corresponding signature definition verified in the 2023 source; use the actual target product definition before comparison.

variables.filter_recurrence: For each pass input x: quick[j+1]=alpha*quick[j]+(1+alpha)/2*(x[j+1]-x[j]); initialize quick at first input value; base=x where quick<0 else x-quick. Reverse direction for second pass using previous base as input, then forward third pass. Reflect 30 values excluding endpoint duplication if n-1>30; trim reflection then clip final base>=0.

variables.name: half_flow_date
variables.formula: mean_y(day_of_hydro_year(first retained date with cumsum(Q_y)>=0.5*sum(Q_y))); each year additionally needs >=300 available Q days
variables.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of annual values across complete Oct-Sep hydrological years 2009-2023 (2008-10-01 through 2023-09-30); each year has equal weight.
variables.eligibility_and_masks: area_km2 < 50000; at least 5 years with >=70% nonmissing daily Q; each annual metric independently needs >=5 nonmissing annual metric values. Each year additionally needs >=300 available days and >=5 such annual dates.
variables.missing_date_handling: Cumulative sum omits missing Q but timing uses actual date relative to Oct1, preserving calendar gaps.
variables.interpolated_discharge: Available Q includes observed and interpolated values (quality_flag 0 and 1); quality_flag is not read by create_paper_signatures.py. Missing Q remains NaN.

comparators.limitations: Related October-origin half-flow timing; coverage thresholds and period differ. CAMELS-RU keeps actual calendar offsets after omitting missing Q; zero-total years return first retained date in current code.
No corresponding signature definition verified in the 2023 source; use the actual target product definition before comparison.

variables.name: winter_flow_ratio
variables.formula: mean(Q_window for Jan-Mar, omit NaN)/mean(Q_window, omit NaN); denominator must be finite and >0; require >=5 Jan-Mar seasons with >=70% available Q
variables.aggregation: Ratio of pooled Jan-Mar mean to pooled all-month mean across complete-year window, including years failing the annual 70% rule, after row eligibility is met.
variables.eligibility_and_masks: area_km2 < 50000; at least 5 years with >=70% nonmissing daily Q; each annual metric independently needs >=5 nonmissing annual metric values. No A-F or quality_flag mask. is_anomalous rows remain in CSV and are excluded from summary statistics; water_balance_screen does not mask signature computation.
variables.missing_date_handling: Missing values omitted separately from seasonal/all-month means; winter_coverage records available Jan-Mar days/total Jan-Mar days; seasonal omissions can bias ratio.
variables.interpolated_discharge: Available Q includes observed and interpolated values (quality_flag 0 and 1); quality_flag is not read by create_paper_signatures.py. Missing Q remains NaN.

comparators.limitations: No direct counterpart in Addor2017 Table 3. This is cold-season yield, not a groundwater fraction; winter gaps alter both samples.
